title: HtmlSpan
responsibility: Renders the native span element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSpan.attributes
inputs.description: Native span attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSpan.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native span element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSpan
outputs.description: The actual native span element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
